row.name: Carrollton Farmers Branch Isd Employee Daycare Academy

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: Three classroom were observed with an outlet cover missing.  This was corrected at inspection when staff provided a cover.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: After investigation, it was determined that a child was left in a classroom unsupervised.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Complying with Laws and Rules: A review of compliance history shows that the operation continues to receive high-weighted deficiencies involving supervision of children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Complying with Laws and Rules (26 TAC §746.201(9))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Through investigation it was determined that caregivers failed to provide the level of supervision necessary to prevent a child from being left on the playground alone.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: Through investigation it was determined that a caregiver grabbed a child by the arm while disciplining the child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: It was determined through investigation that a caregiver did not provide a level of supervision sufficient to prevent a child being separated from the group.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: The walkway on the infant and toddler playground has an area that has lifted about two inches. The gap is large enough to entrap a small child's ankle or trip a larger child or adult Presenting a risk for serious injury..
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space -Gates Locked: A fence at the operation was locked with chain and padlock.  Employees did not have immediate access to the key.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space -Gates Locked (26 TAC §746.4309)

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: During the investigation, it was observed that children were able to leave the playground due to inadequate supervision.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A child was left behind in class and was found alone in the hallway.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: A caregiver was observed leaving the classroom during a transition time when closer supervision was needed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: A caregiver was observed pulling a child by the arm.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments -  Associated with Food, Naps, or Toilet Training: A caregiver was observed taking a child's lunch while she was eating as a punishment for sticking her tongue out at another caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments -  Associated with Food, Naps, or Toilet Training (26 TAC §746.2805(2))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual: A caregiver was observed spraying three children with a water bottle.  The same caregiver was observed yanking a bow out of a child's hair.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual: A caregiver was observed on video footage yanking children, throwing objects at children, and speaking harshly to children in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Interact positively with children: A caregiver was observed on video footage telling children to hit and kick each other.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Interact positively with children (26 TAC §746.1203(5))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Through investigation, one caregiver was observed to be harsh in her treatment of a child when she repositioned him at nap time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: After investigation, it was determined that the operation delayed reporting an incident to Child Care Regulation that placed a child at risk of harm within the required two day period.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: 9 Infants at the operation did not have feeding instructions renewed for September 2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Placing Child in Locked or Dark Room: A caregiver placed a child in a dark, locked room as a form of discipline.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Placing Child in Locked or Dark Room (26 TAC §746.2805(7))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment: Video was reviewed and verified that the caregiver used inappropriate discipline.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §746.2805(1))

occurrences.finding: Training Criteria - Certificate: Standard 746.1309(e)(4),  Preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction training was taken for the 2021-2022 training year, however a certificate was not generated.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Criteria - Certificate (26 TAC §746.1317(c)(4))

occurrences.finding: Sheltering Drills for Lock-Down-4 times in a calendar year: The operation conducts two lock down drills in a calendar year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sheltering Drills for Lock-Down-4 times in a calendar year (26 TAC §746.5205(3))

occurrences.finding: Sheltering Drill For Severe Weather-Four times a calendar year: The operation conducts two severe weather drills in a calendar year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sheltering Drill For Severe Weather-Four times a calendar year (26 TAC §746.5205(2))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Steps-Supplies Kept Out of Child's Reach: Diaper changing supplies were stored in an unlocked cabinet in one classroom. This was corrected at inspection when the diaper supplies were stored out of reach of children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Steps-Supplies Kept Out of Child's Reach (26 TAC §746.3501(6))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: One caregiver was present without an eligible background check.This was corrected at inspection when the caregiver left the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
